base: 2D anime / manhua cel style: bold clean ink outlines, flat colour fills, hard-edged 2-tone shadows (one shadow step, no soft gradients or painterly rendering), limited palette, simple backgrounds. Same character designs across every category.

everyday.name: Everyday / village
everyday.recipe: Paper-white or pale sky background, light airy palette, thin ink lines, almost no shadow. Calm, readable, slice-of-life manhua.

bond.name: Ceremony / bond
bond.recipe: Warm palette (peach blossom pink, gold, lantern red), symmetrical composed framing, soft light but still flat 2-tone shading. Heroic and sincere.

intrigue.name: Intrigue / tension
intrigue.recipe: Dim interiors, single light source, large blocky black shadow shapes, cool or sickly accents. Tight close-ups on faces and hands.

battle.name: Battle / action
battle.recipe: God of High School energy: dynamic angles, speed lines, impact frames, high contrast, saturated accents. Still cel-shaded, never painterly.

omen.name: Supernatural / omen
omen.recipe: Flat graphic glow effects (talisman light, dark wind, well light) as hard-edged shapes, limited eerie palette (yellow, violet, black). GoH-style effects without the motion blur.

aftermath.name: Aftermath / elegy
aftermath.recipe: Muted desaturated palette, wide quiet shots, smoke and ash as flat shapes, night or dusk. Still clean lines; emotion from emptiness, not shading.
